name: Alerts in Discord or Slack
summary: Get a chat message when an outcome in the markets you follow becomes 80% likely.
description:
Workflows can tell you things instead of waiting for you to look. The Webhook node posts a message to a chat channel.

Every 5 minutes this workflow checks the bitcoin markets, and when an outcome's price reaches 0.80, it sends one message to your channel. Each outcome is announced once a day at most.

To get a webhook URL:
- Discord: Server Settings, Integrations, Webhooks, New Webhook, then Copy Webhook URL.
- Slack: add the Incoming Webhooks app to a channel and copy its URL.

The URL works like a password for posting to your channel. It stays in your workflow; sharing the workflow leaves it out.

nodes.notes: Runs every 5 minutes while the workflow is active.
